title: Ladder Capital Corp to Report First Quarter 2026 Results
summary: Ladder Capital Corp (NYSE: LADR) (“we,” “Ladder,” or the “Company”) will release its first quarter 2026 results on Thursday, April 23, 2026 before the open of markets that day. The Company will host a conference call and webcast for investors at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time that day to discuss the financial results. The conference call can be accessed by dialing (877) 407-4018 domestic or (201) 689-8471 international. Individuals who dial in will be asked to identify themselves and their affiliations. For those unable to participate, an audio replay will be available until midnight on Thursday, May 7, 2026. To access the replay, please call (844) 512-2921 domestic or (412) 317-6671 international, access code 13759881. The conference call will also be webcast through a link on Ladder’s Investor Relations website at ir.laddercapital.com/event . A web-based archive of the conference call will be available at the above website. About Ladder Ladder is a publicly listed, investment grade-rated
